$comment: DWS Store FX rates. Base currency EUR. Refreshed daily by scripts/daily/update-fx-rates.sh from ECB Euro reference rates (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/eurofxref-daily.xml). If source is stale, store falls back to values below and displays a 'rates may be out of date' notice after 48h.
